texts.webp: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
texts.bsb: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
texts.asv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

texts.webp: The same was in the beginning with God.
texts.bsb: He was with God in the beginning.
texts.asv: The same was in the beginning with God.

texts.webp: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
texts.bsb: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
texts.asv: All things were made through him; and without him was not anything made that hath been made.

texts.webp: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
texts.bsb: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
texts.asv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

texts.webp: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
texts.bsb: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
texts.asv: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.

texts.webp: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
texts.bsb: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
texts.asv: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

texts.webp: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
texts.bsb: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
texts.asv: The same came for witness, that he might bear witness of the light, that all might believe through him.

texts.webp: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
texts.bsb: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
texts.asv: He was not the light, but came that he might bear witness of the light.

texts.webp: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
texts.bsb: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
texts.asv: There was the true light, even the light which lighteth every man, coming into the world.

texts.webp: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
texts.bsb: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
texts.asv: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world knew him not.

texts.webp: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
texts.bsb: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
texts.asv: He came unto his own, and they that were his own received him not.

texts.webp: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
texts.bsb: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God —
texts.asv: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:

texts.webp: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
texts.bsb: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
texts.asv: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

texts.webp: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
texts.bsb: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
texts.asv: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.

texts.webp: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
texts.bsb: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
texts.asv: John beareth witness of him, and crieth, saying, This was he of whom I said, He that cometh after me is become before me: for he was before me.

texts.webp: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
texts.bsb: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
texts.asv: For of his fulness we all received, and grace for grace.

texts.webp: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
texts.bsb: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
texts.asv: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

texts.webp: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
texts.bsb: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
texts.asv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

texts.webp: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
texts.bsb: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
texts.asv: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent unto him from Jerusalem priests and Levites to ask him, Who art thou?

texts.webp: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
texts.bsb: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
texts.asv: And he confessed, and denied not; and he confessed, I am not the Christ.

texts.webp: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?”
texts.bsb: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?”
texts.asv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou the prophet? And he answered, No.

texts.webp: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
texts.bsb: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
texts.asv: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

texts.webp: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
texts.bsb: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet:
texts.asv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

texts.webp: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
texts.bsb: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
texts.asv: And they had been sent from the Pharisees.

texts.webp: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
texts.bsb: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
texts.asv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why then baptizest thou, if thou art not the Christ, neither Elijah, neither the prophet?

texts.webp: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
texts.bsb: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands One you do not know.
texts.asv: John answered them, saying, I baptize in water: in the midst of you standeth one whom ye know not,

texts.webp: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
texts.bsb: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
texts.asv: even he that cometh after me, the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to unloose.

texts.webp: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
texts.bsb: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
texts.asv: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

texts.webp: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
texts.bsb: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
texts.asv: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!

texts.webp: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
texts.bsb: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
texts.asv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is become before me: for he was before me.

texts.webp: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
texts.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
texts.asv: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.

texts.webp: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
texts.bsb: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
texts.asv: And John bare witness, saying, I have beheld the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven; and it abode upon him.

texts.webp: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
texts.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
texts.asv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize in water, he said unto me, Upon whomsoever thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and abiding upon him, the same is he that baptizeth in the Holy Spirit.

texts.webp: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
texts.bsb: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God. ”
texts.asv: And I have seen, and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.

texts.webp: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
texts.bsb: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
texts.asv: Again on the morrow John was standing, and two of his disciples;

texts.webp: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
texts.bsb: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
texts.asv: and he looked upon Jesus as he walked, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God!

texts.webp: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
texts.bsb: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
texts.asv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

texts.webp: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?”
texts.bsb: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked.
texts.asv: And Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?

texts.webp: He said to them, “Come and see.”
texts.bsb: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
texts.asv: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.

texts.webp: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
texts.bsb: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
texts.asv: One of the two that heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

texts.webp: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ ).
texts.bsb: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
texts.asv: He findeth first his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messiah (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

texts.webp: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
texts.bsb: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
texts.asv: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).

texts.webp: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
texts.bsb: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
texts.asv: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.

texts.webp: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
texts.bsb: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
texts.asv: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

texts.webp: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
texts.bsb: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold — Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
texts.asv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

texts.webp: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?”
texts.bsb: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked.
texts.asv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

texts.webp: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
texts.bsb: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
texts.asv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

texts.webp: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?”
texts.bsb: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked.
texts.asv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

texts.webp: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
texts.bsb: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
texts.asv: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art King of Israel.

texts.webp: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
texts.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

texts.webp: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
texts.bsb: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
texts.asv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

texts.webp: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
texts.bsb: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
texts.asv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

texts.webp: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
texts.bsb: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
texts.asv: and Jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.

texts.webp: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
texts.bsb: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
texts.asv: And when the wine failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

texts.webp: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
texts.bsb: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
texts.asv: And Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

texts.webp: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
texts.bsb: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
texts.asv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

texts.webp: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
texts.bsb: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
texts.asv: Now there were six waterpots of stone set there after the Jews’ manner of purifying, containing two or three firkins apiece.

texts.webp: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
texts.bsb: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.”
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

texts.webp: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
texts.bsb: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.”
texts.asv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. And they bare it.

texts.webp: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
texts.bsb: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
texts.asv: And when the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and knew not whence it was (but the servants that had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast calleth the bridegroom,

texts.webp: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
texts.bsb: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
texts.asv: and saith unto him, Every man setteth on first the good wine; and when men have drunk freely, then that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.

texts.webp: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
texts.bsb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
texts.asv: This beginning of his signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

texts.webp: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
texts.bsb: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
texts.asv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.

texts.webp: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
texts.bsb: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
texts.asv: And the passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

texts.webp: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
texts.bsb: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
texts.asv: And he found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

texts.webp: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
texts.bsb: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
texts.asv: and he made a scourge of cords, and cast all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables;

texts.webp: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
texts.bsb: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
texts.asv: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house a house of merchandise.

texts.webp: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
texts.bsb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
texts.asv: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.

texts.webp: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
texts.bsb: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”
texts.asv: The Jews therefore answered and said unto him, What sign showest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

texts.webp: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
texts.bsb: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

texts.webp: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
texts.bsb: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
texts.asv: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?

texts.webp: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
texts.bsb: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body.
texts.asv: But he spake of the temple of his body.

texts.webp: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
texts.bsb: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
texts.asv: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he spake this; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

texts.webp: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
texts.bsb: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
texts.asv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, during the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he did.

texts.webp: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
texts.bsb: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
texts.asv: But Jesus did not trust himself unto them, for that he knew all men,

texts.webp: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
texts.bsb: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
texts.asv: and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

texts.webp: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
texts.bsb: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
texts.asv: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

texts.webp: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
texts.bsb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
texts.asv: the same came unto him by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that thou doest, except God be with him.

texts.webp: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
texts.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again. ”
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

texts.webp: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
texts.bsb: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
texts.asv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

texts.webp: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
texts.bsb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
texts.asv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

texts.webp: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
texts.bsb: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
texts.asv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

texts.webp: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
texts.bsb: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
texts.asv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born anew.

texts.webp: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
texts.bsb: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
texts.asv: The wind bloweth where it will, and thou hearest the voice thereof, but knowest not whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

texts.webp: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
texts.bsb: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
texts.asv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

texts.webp: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
texts.bsb: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou the teacher of Israel, and understandest not these things?

texts.webp: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
texts.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
texts.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that which we know, and bear witness of that which we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

texts.webp: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
texts.bsb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
texts.asv: If I told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe if I tell you heavenly things?

texts.webp: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
texts.bsb: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven— the Son of Man.
texts.asv: And no one hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended out of heaven, even the Son of man, who is in heaven.

texts.webp: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
texts.bsb: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
texts.asv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up;

texts.webp: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
texts.bsb: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
texts.asv: that whosoever believeth may in him have eternal life.

texts.webp: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
texts.bsb: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
texts.asv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth on him should not perish, but have eternal life.

texts.webp: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
texts.bsb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
texts.asv: For God sent not the Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.

texts.webp: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
texts.bsb: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
texts.asv: He that believeth on him is not judged: he that believeth not hath been judged already, because he hath not believed on the name of the only begotten Son of God.

texts.webp: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
texts.bsb: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
texts.asv: And this is the judgment, that the light is come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

texts.webp: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
texts.bsb: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
texts.asv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, and cometh not to the light, lest his works should be reproved.

texts.webp: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
texts.bsb: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
texts.asv: But he that doeth the truth cometh to the light, that his works may be made manifest, that they have been wrought in God.

texts.webp: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
texts.bsb: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
texts.asv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

texts.webp: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
texts.bsb: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
texts.asv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

texts.webp: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
texts.bsb: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
texts.asv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

texts.webp: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
texts.bsb: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
texts.asv: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with a Jew about purifying.

texts.webp: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
texts.bsb: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about — He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
texts.asv: And they came unto John, and said to him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond the Jordan, to whom thou hast borne witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

texts.webp: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
texts.bsb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
texts.asv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it have been given him from heaven.

texts.webp: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
texts.bsb: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
texts.asv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but, that I am sent before him.

texts.webp: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
texts.bsb: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
texts.asv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, that standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is made full.

texts.webp: He must increase, but I must decrease.
texts.bsb: He must increase; I must decrease.
texts.asv: He must increase, but I must decrease.

texts.webp: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
texts.bsb: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
texts.asv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is of the earth, and of the earth he speaketh: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

texts.webp: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
texts.bsb: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
texts.asv: What he hath seen and heard, of that he beareth witness; and no man receiveth his witness.

texts.webp: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
texts.bsb: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
texts.asv: He that hath received his witness hath set his seal to this, that God is true.

texts.webp: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
texts.bsb: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
texts.asv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for he giveth not the Spirit by measure.

texts.webp: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
texts.bsb: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
texts.asv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

texts.webp: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
texts.bsb: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
texts.asv: He that believeth on the Son hath eternal life; but he that obeyeth not the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abideth on him.

texts.webp: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
texts.bsb: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
texts.asv: When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

texts.webp: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
texts.bsb: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
texts.asv: (although Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples),

texts.webp: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
texts.bsb: He left Judea and returned to Galilee.
texts.asv: he left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.

texts.webp: He needed to pass through Samaria.
texts.bsb: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
texts.asv: And he must needs pass through Samaria.

texts.webp: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
texts.bsb: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
texts.asv: So he cometh to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph:

texts.webp: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
texts.bsb: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
texts.asv: and Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

texts.webp: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
texts.bsb: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
texts.asv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

texts.webp: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
texts.bsb: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
texts.asv: For his disciples were gone away into the city to buy food.

texts.webp: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
texts.bsb: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
texts.asv: The Samaritan woman therefore saith unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, who am a Samaritan woman? (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

texts.webp: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
texts.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

texts.webp: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
texts.bsb: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
texts.asv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: whence then hast thou that living water?

texts.webp: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
texts.bsb: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
texts.asv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his sons, and his cattle?

texts.webp: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
texts.bsb: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
texts.asv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Every one that drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

texts.webp: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
texts.bsb: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
texts.asv: but whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall become in him a well of water springing up unto eternal life.

texts.webp: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
texts.bsb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
texts.asv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come all the way hither to draw.

texts.webp: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
texts.bsb: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

texts.webp: The woman answered, “I have no husband.”
texts.bsb: “I have no husband,” the woman replied.
texts.asv: The woman answered and said unto him, I have no husband. Jesus saith unto her, Thou saidst well, I have no husband:

texts.webp: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
texts.bsb: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
texts.asv: for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: this hast thou said truly.

texts.webp: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
texts.bsb: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
texts.asv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

texts.webp: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
texts.bsb: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
texts.asv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

texts.webp: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
texts.bsb: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father.

texts.webp: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
texts.bsb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
texts.asv: Ye worship that which ye know not: we worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

texts.webp: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
texts.bsb: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
texts.asv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth: for such doth the Father seek to be his worshippers.

texts.webp: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
texts.bsb: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
texts.asv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

texts.webp: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
texts.bsb: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
texts.asv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messiah cometh (he that is called Christ): when he is come, he will declare unto us all things.

texts.webp: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
texts.bsb: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

texts.webp: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
texts.bsb: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”
texts.asv: And upon this came his disciples; and they marvelled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why speakest thou with her?

texts.webp: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
texts.bsb: Then the woman left her water jar, went back into the town, and said to the people,
texts.asv: So the woman left her waterpot, and went away into the city, and saith to the people,

texts.webp: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
texts.bsb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
texts.asv: Come, see a man, who told me all things that ever I did: can this be the Christ?

texts.webp: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
texts.bsb: So they left the town and made their way toward Jesus.
texts.asv: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

texts.webp: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
texts.bsb: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
texts.asv: In the mean while the disciples prayed him, saying, Rabbi, eat.

texts.webp: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
texts.bsb: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
texts.asv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not.

texts.webp: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
texts.bsb: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
texts.asv: The disciples therefore said one to another, Hath any man brought him aught to eat?

texts.webp: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
texts.bsb: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to accomplish his work.

texts.webp: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
texts.bsb: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
texts.asv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh the harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields, that they are white already unto harvest.

texts.webp: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
texts.bsb: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
texts.asv: He that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal; that he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

texts.webp: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
texts.bsb: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
texts.asv: For herein is the saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

texts.webp: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
texts.bsb: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.”
texts.asv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye have not labored: others have labored, and ye are entered into their labor.

texts.webp: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
texts.bsb: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
texts.asv: And from that city many of the Samaritans believed on him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me all things that ever I did.

texts.webp: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
texts.bsb: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
texts.asv: So when the Samaritans came unto him, they besought him to abide with them: and he abode there two days.

texts.webp: Many more believed because of his word.
texts.bsb: And many more believed because of His message.
texts.asv: And many more believed because of his word;

texts.webp: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
texts.bsb: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.”
texts.asv: and they said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy speaking: for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.

texts.webp: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
texts.bsb: After two days, Jesus left for Galilee.
texts.asv: And after the two days he went forth from thence into Galilee.

texts.webp: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
texts.bsb: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
texts.asv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honor in his own country.

texts.webp: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
texts.bsb: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
texts.asv: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

texts.webp: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
texts.bsb: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
texts.asv: He came therefore again unto Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

texts.webp: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
texts.bsb: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
texts.asv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.

texts.webp: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
texts.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
texts.asv: Jesus therefore said unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.

texts.webp: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
texts.bsb: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
texts.asv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

texts.webp: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
texts.bsb: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.”
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. The man believed the word that Jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.

texts.webp: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
texts.bsb: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive.
texts.asv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, saying, that his son lived.

texts.webp: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
texts.bsb: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour. ”
texts.asv: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to amend. They said therefore unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

texts.webp: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
texts.bsb: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
texts.asv: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

texts.webp: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
texts.bsb: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
texts.asv: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judæa into Galilee.

texts.webp: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
texts.bsb: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
texts.asv: After these things there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

texts.webp: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
texts.bsb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
texts.asv: Now there is in Jerusalem by the sheep gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches.

texts.webp: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
texts.bsb: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed.
texts.asv: In these lay a multitude of them that were sick, blind, halt, withered.

texts.webp: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
texts.bsb: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
texts.asv: And a certain man was there, who had been thirty and eight years in his infirmity.

texts.webp: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
texts.bsb: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
texts.asv: When Jesus saw him lying, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wouldest thou be made whole?

texts.webp: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
texts.bsb: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
texts.asv: The sick man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

texts.webp: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
texts.bsb: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
texts.asv: Jesus saith unto him, Arise, take up thy bed, and walk.

texts.webp: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked.
texts.bsb: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk.
texts.asv: And straightway the man was made whole, and took up his bed and walked.

texts.webp: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
texts.bsb: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
texts.asv: So the Jews said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath, and it is not lawful for thee to take up thy bed.

texts.webp: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”
texts.bsb: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
texts.asv: But he answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

texts.webp: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
texts.bsb: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
texts.asv: They asked him, Who is the man that said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

texts.webp: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
texts.bsb: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
texts.asv: But he that was healed knew not who it was; for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in the place.

texts.webp: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
texts.bsb: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
texts.asv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing befall thee.

texts.webp: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
texts.bsb: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
texts.asv: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.

texts.webp: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
texts.bsb: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
texts.asv: And for this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, because he did these things on the sabbath.

texts.webp: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
texts.bsb: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
texts.asv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh even until now, and I work.

texts.webp: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
texts.bsb: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
texts.asv: For this cause therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only brake the sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

texts.webp: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
texts.bsb: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
texts.asv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father doing: for what things soever he doeth, these the Son also doeth in like manner.

texts.webp: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
texts.bsb: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
texts.asv: For the Father loveth the Son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and greater works than these will he show him, that ye may marvel.

texts.webp: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
texts.bsb: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
texts.asv: For as the Father raiseth the dead and giveth them life, even so the Son also giveth life to whom he will.

texts.webp: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
texts.bsb: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
texts.asv: For neither doth the Father judge any man, but he hath given all judgment unto the Son;

texts.webp: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
texts.bsb: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
texts.asv: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honoreth not the Son honoreth not the Father that sent him.

texts.webp: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
texts.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
texts.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth him that sent me, hath eternal life, and cometh not into judgment, but hath passed out of death into life.

texts.webp: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
texts.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
texts.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; and they that hear shall live.

texts.webp: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
texts.bsb: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
texts.asv: For as the Father hath life in himself, even so gave he to the Son also to have life in himself:

texts.webp: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
texts.bsb: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
texts.asv: and he gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

texts.webp: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
texts.bsb: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
texts.asv: Marvel not at this: for the hour cometh, in which all that are in the tombs shall hear his voice,

texts.webp: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
texts.bsb: and come out — those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
texts.asv: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of judgment.

texts.webp: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
texts.bsb: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
texts.asv: I can of myself do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is righteous; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

texts.webp: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
texts.bsb: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
texts.asv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

texts.webp: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
texts.bsb: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
texts.asv: It is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

texts.webp: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
texts.bsb: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
texts.asv: Ye have sent unto John, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.

texts.webp: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
texts.bsb: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
texts.asv: But the witness which I receive is not from man: howbeit I say these things, that ye may be saved.

texts.webp: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
texts.bsb: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
texts.asv: He was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.

texts.webp: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
texts.bsb: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish — the very works I am doing — testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
texts.asv: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

texts.webp: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
texts.bsb: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
texts.asv: And the Father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

texts.webp: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
texts.bsb: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
texts.asv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.

texts.webp: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
texts.bsb: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
texts.asv: Ye search the scriptures, because ye think that in them ye have eternal life; and these are they which bear witness of me;

texts.webp: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
texts.bsb: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
texts.asv: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.

texts.webp: I don’t receive glory from men.
texts.bsb: I do not accept glory from men,
texts.asv: I receive not glory from men.

texts.webp: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
texts.bsb: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
texts.asv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in yourselves.

texts.webp: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
texts.bsb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
texts.asv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

texts.webp: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
texts.bsb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
texts.asv: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that cometh from the only God ye seek not?

texts.webp: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
texts.bsb: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
texts.asv: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, on whom ye have set your hope.

texts.webp: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
texts.bsb: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
texts.asv: For if ye believed Moses, ye would believe me; for he wrote of me.

texts.webp: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
texts.bsb: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
texts.asv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

texts.webp: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
texts.bsb: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee ( that is, the Sea of Tiberias ).
texts.asv: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

texts.webp: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
texts.bsb: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
texts.asv: And a great multitude followed him, because they beheld the signs which he did on them that were sick.

texts.webp: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
texts.bsb: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
texts.asv: And Jesus went up into the mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

texts.webp: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
texts.bsb: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
texts.asv: Now the passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

texts.webp: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
texts.bsb: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
texts.asv: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude cometh unto him, saith unto Philip, Whence are we to buy bread, that these may eat?

texts.webp: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
texts.bsb: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
texts.asv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

texts.webp: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
texts.bsb: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
texts.asv: Philip answered him, Two hundred shillings’ worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one may take a little.

texts.webp: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
texts.bsb: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
texts.asv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,

texts.webp: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
texts.bsb: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
texts.asv: There is a lad here, who hath five barley loaves, and two fishes: but what are these among so many?

texts.webp: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
texts.bsb: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
texts.asv: Jesus said, Make the people sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

texts.webp: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
texts.bsb: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
texts.asv: Jesus therefore took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to them that were set down; likewise also of the fishes as much as they would.

texts.webp: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
texts.bsb: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
texts.asv: And when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.

texts.webp: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
texts.bsb: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
texts.asv: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which remained over unto them that had eaten.

texts.webp: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
texts.bsb: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
texts.asv: When therefore the people saw the sign which he did, they said, This is of a truth the prophet that cometh into the world.

texts.webp: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
texts.bsb: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.
texts.asv: Jesus therefore perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again into the mountain himself alone.

texts.webp: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
texts.bsb: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
texts.asv: And when evening came, his disciples went down unto the sea;

texts.webp: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
texts.bsb: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
texts.asv: and they entered into a boat, and were going over the sea unto Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.

texts.webp: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
texts.bsb: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
texts.asv: And the sea was rising by reason of a great wind that blew.

texts.webp: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
texts.bsb: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea — and they were terrified.
texts.asv: When therefore they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they behold Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the boat: and they were afraid.

texts.webp: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
texts.bsb: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
texts.asv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

texts.webp: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
texts.bsb: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
texts.asv: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat: and straightway the boat was at the land whither they were going.
